description: Removes an organization member from a Sentry team, revoking their team-specific permissions, provided the member is currently part of that team.

inputSchema.description: Specifies the organization, member, and team for the removal operation.

member_id.description: Identifier (ID) of the organization member to remove from the team (e.g., '234567'). Typically a numerical ID.
member_id.title: Member Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: Identifier (ID) or slug of the Sentry organization (e.g., 'our-company', '123456'). Slugs are typically lowercase and hyphenated.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

team_id_or_slug.description: Identifier (ID) or slug of the Sentry team from which the member will be removed (e.g., 'frontend-developers', '98765'). Team slugs are typically lowercase and hyphenated.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: DeleteMemberFromTeamRequest

name: delete_member_from_team

DeleteMemberFromTeamResponse.description: Response after successfully removing a member from a team. Returns HTTP 200 with team details showing the updated membership status.

access.description: List of permission scopes granted to the user for this team
access.title: Access

dateCreated.description: Team creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format (nullable)
dateCreated.title: Date Created

flags.description: Feature flags for the team (e.g., idp:provisioned)
flags.title: Flags

hasAccess.description: Whether the user has access to the team
hasAccess.title: Has Access

isMember.description: Whether the requester is a member of the team
isMember.title: Is Member

isPending.description: Whether the membership is pending approval
isPending.title: Is Pending

memberCount.description: Current number of members in the team
memberCount.title: Member Count

DeleteMemberFromTeamResponse.title: DeleteMemberFromTeamResponse

TeamAvatar.description: Avatar configuration for a Sentry team.
TeamAvatar.title: TeamAvatar
